root_causes.title: Large temporaries peak from full-vocabulary logits materialization in MSE loss
Optimizer state (Adam moments) at 4.57 GB for 204 param blocks

plan.title: Chunk cross-entropy loss over vocabulary to avoid full logits tensor
plan.description: Replace MSE loss (predictions - targets).square().mean() with chunked cross-entropy computed by streaming logits from the final Linear projection. Process vocabulary in chunks (e.g., 4096 classes) using torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy with ignore_index and label_smoothing preserved; do not materialize the full [batch*seq, vocab] FP32 logits tensor. Move any existing FP32 conversion into the chunked loop without changing computation dtypes. Ensure backward recomputes per chunk or uses an equivalent implementation so autograd graphs do not retain all chunks simultaneously. Preserve original reduction (mean over valid elements), mask
plan.risk: Floating-point summation order changes across chunks may alter loss values beyond host tolerance; host verification must confirm loss equivalence. Requires source evidence that loss is cross-entropy over full vocabulary; not applicable if objective differs

notes: Peak temporaries 9.16 GB likely from full logits materialization; chunked cross-entropy can avoid this if loss objective matches.
Overlap between optimizer state savings and temporaries savings is possible; estimates are not additive.
Missing runtime evidence: exact loss function semantics (cross-entropy vs MSE), vocabulary size, label smoothing, ignore_index, mask/reduction axes.

evidence_requests.detail: Source shows MSE loss (predictions - targets).square().mean() at line 144, but cross-entropy chunking only applies if the true objective is cross-entropy from full-vocabulary logits. Need confirmation of actual loss semantics, vocabulary size, and any label_smoothing/ignore_index/mask.

No evidence of an existing chunked cross-entropy implementation or helper in the supplied source. Need to know if an equivalent streaming implementation is available or must be written, and whether it preserves the exact reduction, masks, class weights, ignore_index, and label_smoothing.
